added_lines: the parishes of greenlough and bellaghy/ballysculli on 25 october 2026 - the thirtieth sunday of the yea r this week’s diary : monday 26 – bellaghy, mass, 9.30am tuesday 27 – greenlough, mass, 9.30am; rosary: 7.30pm wednesday 28 – bellaghy, mass, 9.30am thursday 29 – greenlough, adoration, 9.00am – 5.00pm friday 30 – bellaghy, adoration, 10.00am – 7.00pm (rosary at 6.30pm). mass: 7.00pm. saturday 31 october – vigil of all saints’ day: greenlough, mass, 5.30pm (streamed to bellaghy) sunday 1 november - all saints’ day mass: ballyscullion, 9.45am; bellaghy, 11.00am (streamed to greenlough). monday 2 november is all souls’ day - mass times bellaghy, 9.30am; greenlough, 7.30pm. tuesday 3 november – st malachy’s gac: the annual club mass for deceased members will be celebrated in the pavilion at 7.30pm. everyone welcome. refreshments afte rwards. deaths : we offer our sympathy to the families and friends of kathleen brennan, lavey, and mary mawhinney, ballyscullion road, who died recently. anniversaries 24/25 october: margaret doherty (1st anniversary) raymond craig (anniversary mass fri 30 october, at 7pm), fr. liam donnelly, callum dougan, arthur o’neill, sarah tohill, elizabeth hanson, patrick joseph mclaughlin, eileen devlin, mary anne mcatamney, harry mcallen, sean larkin, brendan quigley, pat ricia henry, kate o’donnell, margaret mcgurk, pat joe o’hagan, annie madden, rosemary madden, maggie mckillen, mary clarke. anniversaries next weekend (31 october/1 november): peggy mcerlean (anniversary mass at 11am), patrick mckenna, michael mcglinchey, peter mck enna, peter kealey, connie potter. may they rest in peace. the annual mass for our deceased parishioners and friends will be celebrated in st mary’s church, bellaghy, on friday 6 november at 7pm. there will be an opportunity to light a candle in remembrance of parishioners who have died since last november. there will be a service of prayer for the deceased members of our parish in st oliver plunkett church, clady, at 7pm on fri 13 nov. all three churches will have a box available at the altar in whic h you can put the names of those you wish to be remembered in our prayers during november, the month of the holy souls. greenlough: november: church cleaning team: kathy mcerlean, pauline mcerlean, martina mackle, christina carey. counters: declan maguire, pauline mcateer, liam mcateer, rosemarie mcallist er greenlough

7-day pilgrimage to fatima, 28 june 2027. £975 per person sharing (£875 if paid in full by 30 november 2026) to include flights from belfast, full board, full religio us programme. for further details, please contact christina lagan on

. vocations : st paul reminds the thessalonians that it was “…with the joy of the holy spirit that [they] took to the gospel…” we pray for the future priests of the diocese that they will feel the joy that comes from the holy spirit as they read, live, and preach the good news of god’s love. there will be a gathering for men aged 18-40 interested in diocesan p riesthood, in derry, on sunday 8 november, 4-7.30pm. anyone interested should co ntact the diocesan vocations director, fr pat o’hagan. we hope to form a greenlough youth parish pastoral council, beginning in january 2027. anyone aged 16-30 who would like to be involved, please contact shea mcpeake (

the parishes of greenlough and bellaghy/ballysculli on 25 october 2026 - the thirtieth sunday of the yea r the next greenlough parish day of prayer in the movement of continuous prayer for marriage and family life will be wednesday 29 october. in november we remember our beloved dead. our parish pastoral councils would like to promote devotion to the real presence of jesus in the blessed sacrament, building on the adoration already taking place on thursdays and fridays. to that end we will welcome speakers from t he diocesan adoration committee to all our weekend masses on 14/15 november. also, we hope to run a six-week programme on the eucharist during lent 2027. lent will begin on ash wednesday, 10 february. anyone who would like to be involved, please leave your name and contact detail at either parish office. indulgences for the holy souls from 12noon on 1 november until midnight on 2 november, all who have confessed, received holy communion and prayed for the pope’s intentions ( one our father and hail mary, or any other prayer of one’s choice), gain one plenary indulgence by visiting a church or oratory, and there reciting one our father and apostles’ creed. this indulgence is applicable only to the souls of the departed. confession may be made at any time within the week prece ding or the week following 1 november. holy communion may be received on any day from 1 – 8 november. the faithful who visit a cemetery and pray for the dead may gain a plenary indulgence applicable only to the holy souls on the usual conditions, one per day from 1-8 november, under the same conditions.
